ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Dr!ve uses your location to record your car trips (distance, duration, speed and route). Your trips stay on your iPhone.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Dr!ve uses your location in the background to detect and record car trips automatically, even when the app is closed. Trips and routes stay on your iPhone and are never uploaded.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Dr!ve uses Motion & Fitness to recognise when you are in a car, so GPS only runs on real trips and saves battery. No health data is read.
